description: This file configures the Angular application's core setup, including routing, zone change detection, and client hydration settings.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Enables or configures Angular's zone change detection, optimizing event handling.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing configuration for the Angular application with specified routes.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables hydration for server-side rendered Angular applications.

methods.name: withEventReplay
methods.description: Configures client hydration to replay events for better user experience during hydration.
